metadata.description: Two mutually exclusive Rails conventions packs for Claude Code: layered architecture, and vanilla Rails per the 37signals playbook

plugins.name: rails-layered
plugins.description: Layered Rails 8 architecture: service, query, form, policy and presenter objects, RSpec + FactoryBot, Pundit, ViewComponent, Tailwind, PostgreSQL. Ships 18 specialist agents and 54 skills, including a spec-driven-development kit.

plugins.name: rails-37signals
plugins.description: Vanilla Rails per the 37signals playbook: rich models, namespaced concerns, state records, CRUD-everything controllers, Minitest + fixtures, plain CSS, no service layer. Extracted from fizzy, once-campfire and writebook with a citation into real code behind each rule.
